maddeler.e:
نتزحزح (form IIq)
# نَتَزَحْزَحُ (natazaḥzaḥu) /na.ta.zaħ.za.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَزَحْزَحَ (tazaḥzaḥa)
# نَتَزَحْزَحَ (natazaḥzaḥa) /na.ta.zaħ.za.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَزَحْزَحَ (tazaḥzaḥa)
# نَتَزَحْزَحْ (natazaḥzaḥ) /na.ta.zaħ.zaħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَزَحْزَحَ (tazaḥzaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
